summary: No SPY bet: the day after Monday's 5% gap, SPY is -1.3% and QQQ -2.3% pre-market as chips give back part of it and two AI-hardware reports disappoint; nothing points one way from the open.
reasons: Why down (Reuters via Investing.com, Benzinga, Yahoo live): profit taking in chips after Monday's Nvidia-led rally (NVDA +31.5% on the day); HPE beat but guided its first quarter and its AI margins short (-11% pre-market); ADI beat and guided below consensus (-10%); Benzinga also cites fresh Iran sanctions and Hormuz warnings from Treasury. Sanofi is buying Insmed for $41 billion.

Rates and data: the 10-year near 4.93% (sources disagree on the move); one aggregator puts December hike odds at 95% (single source, not confirmed). 10:00 Conference Board consumer confidence (consensus about 92) and Richmond Fed; 13:00 a $70 billion 5-year note auction (one source). Wednesday 08:30: October PCE and the second estimate of third-quarter GDP. Thursday closed, Friday a half day.

Monday: SPY gapped +5.0% and closed 0.28% under its open; the base rate quoted that morning (the day after a -2% day in a falling month) is now 0 for 2 since it went on file. R1: the gap is priced at the open; no base rate is quoted today. The selling deepened from 07:58 (SPY -0.9%) to 08:31 (-1.3%), all of it before the open.

Sniper null: no qualifying rating change. Bernstein initiates AMD at Buy and BofA initiates WDC at Buy: initiations, not rating changes (R4 was measured on upgrades and downgrades), and both gap down 4-5% with the group. BNP downgrades MU to Neutral: a put sniper needs a put day (S4). Guggenheim upgrades CRWD to Buy: CRWD reported Monday morning, so today is inside its report window (R3). Morgan Stanley's upgrade is of Millicom, not ours.

No ideas listed (T6). Every candidate is a call on a name gapping down with the chip group after a 15-30% day, or a name inside a report window; nothing with a cause of its own that is not already in the opening price.

Report window (R3): ADI reported this morning; DELL and WDAY report after today's close; HPE reported last night; CRWD reported Monday. DE reports Wednesday. None of our 25 names reports in the next week except as above; CRM and MRVL next week.

Theme states at the 11-23 close: chips neutral (BREADTH), software neutral (REL_WEAK, BREADTH), optical neutral with heat flags (REL_STRONG, PERIPH_UP), consumer BREADTH_UP; light lit: breadth. Neither chips nor software is `turning` any more after Monday. Described, not forecast (R6).

Pre-market down gaps of 2% or more among the large caps: NVDA, AMD, MU, AVGO, INTC, ORCL, TXN, ADI, HPE, DELL, MRVL, LITE, WDC, STX, SNDK, ARM, PLTR, TSM. nvda_gapdown_put (real ledger, $691) can fire at 10:00 if NVDA is still under its open.
events: DELL and WDAY after the close
Wednesday 08:30 PCE and GDP; Thursday closed; Friday half day

inputs.overnight: TSMC limit-up in Taipei after the Nvidia news (Benzinga 04:31); US futures lower from the European morning: Nasdaq 100 about -1.2%, S&P 500 about -0.5% at the first reports. VIX is Monday's close.

rotation.note: Monday's bounce turned the chip weeks positive (GPU +5.7%, disk +5.0% 1w) but every tech theme is still 15-31% down on the month and every sector ETF except staples is under its 20-day average; this morning the bounce is partly given back. R6: describes, does not forecast.

theme_state.lights: breadth lit at the 11-23 close; stretched not lit

zh.summary: 今天不下注。昨天高开 5% 后，今早标普盘前 -1.3%、纳指 -2.3%，芯片在回吐昨天的大涨，惠普企业和亚德诺两家 AI 硬件公司的指引不及预期。开盘后往哪边走，看不出理由，我写 0.50。
zh.sniper: 今天不点名：伯恩斯坦首次覆盖 AMD 给买入、美银首次覆盖西部数据给买入，都是首次覆盖、不是评级上调，而且两只都跟着芯片低开 4% 到 5%；法巴下调美光是降级，看跌只在看跌日做；古根海姆上调 CrowdStrike，但它昨天刚出财报，还在窗口里。想法清单也空着。
